verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents its own webhook notifications (Webhooks and IPN), and its MCP server can configure and monitor them, which loosely suggests some visibility into deliveries. Signature verification, automatic delivery retries and replay are not evidenced. The 'automatic retries' item refers to retrying rejected subscription payments, not webhook redelivery, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: signed webhook payloads, automatic delivery retries, documented event/delivery logs, event replay, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state
